title: The three requirement conditions hold once the weight parameter exceeds the explicit componentwise threshold
author: Zhihao Qiao, Budhi Surya, Azam Asanjarani, Yoni Nazarathy
work: Multi-Absorbing Phase-Type Distributions for Right-Censored Competing Risks Data
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: original Proposition 8 of the article (source label prop:init-omega, source0.tex lines 1570--1586): the three requirement conditions hold simultaneously for every component k = 1,...,n as soon as the weight parameter omega exceeds the maximum of the explicit piecewise thresholds omega*\_k. It is delivered with the authors' own complete 24-line proof at source0.tex lines 1587--1610. H2: the proof is an algebraic reduction rather than a qualifying examination computation: the solver must substitute psi = omega*mu\_k into the squared-coefficient identity to turn requirement (1) into psi > 1, rewrite the squared coefficient of variation in terms of psi, and then compare the resulting rational polynomial g(psi) against its denominator on each of the three regimes of the piecewise threshold to identify where the conditions hold. Reconstructing that three-regime comparison is well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying level.
